name: dsh-plan-mode-plus
description: ZCode-style plan mode for DeepSeek Harness: model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard read-only enforcement while planning, and the four-phase planning workflow — builds on the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=lib/index.js --legal-comments=none && node scripts/disable-eval.mjs && esbuild src/client.tsx --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=lib/client.js --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react-dom --legal-comments=none --banner:js="window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: \"dsh-plan-mode-plus\", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;" --footer:js="return module.exports; } });"
